description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named NotesController that provides CRUD API endpoints for managing notes. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, listing, updating, and deleting notes, with optional user scoping via request headers. It also incorporates Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: NotesController
classes.description: REST controller providing CRUD operations for notes with optional user scoping.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note, using the owner id extracted from the request headers.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a note by its unique ID, applying owner scoping if provided.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all notes, optionally scoped to the owner if specified.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID, with owner scoping if provided.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID, considering owner scoping.
